Physicist

This character has sworn to the esoteric order of Physicism, believing the world Monad forged was built upon the the gleaming brilliance of the smallest streams of life and that the rebellious spirits of Atomos simply misunderstood the honor bestowed by Monad to create Wisdom.
Physicians

This character has sworn to the Hippocratic Oath believing the world Monad forged upon the stream can be learnt through the studious application of reason by understanding how the life-stream interacts with the essence of mortality.
Forgers
This character has sworn on the Order of the Forgers, a great guild of Humanity whom forged the great machines of Old which was used to shape the world in the image of Monad's Great Wisdom.
Idealism

This character is a follower of Idealism believing the world was forged upon the will of Humanity's Perception of the Divine Force of Truth and thus train vigorously to "change" their reality so that they may become closer to Ultimate Enlightment.
Existentialism

This character is a follower of Existentialism believing the World was forged upon the Enlightment of the Creator so that humanity could experience his creation. They rigorously apply themselves so that may understand all aspects of this reality to attain Enlightment.
Romanticism

This character is a follower of Romanticism for which "Beauty is in the eye of the Beholder". Believing the World was an expression of the Creator's divine spark of creativity rather than the 5 maxims of Truth of which all follow in their own ways to attain Enlightment.
Realism

This character, is a follower of Realism who uphold the 5 maxims of Truth as the Creator's one truth to enlightment shunning the excess speculation on the divinty of plan for simply enjoying the world as the Creator had created it.
Associate

The Rank of Associate are initiates to the Neuhumanist Rite of "University". While they have trained their mind to precieve the true clear rational of reason, they have not yet reached even a cursory understanding of divine reason. As such they remain only at the surface of this most treasured institution.
Bachelor

The Rank of Bachelor are low level members in the Neuhumanist Rite of "University". They have trained their mind to precieve the true clear rational of reason, they have made a modest step into all the rites and have thus grasp a modest understanding of divine reason. As such they are honored with a gold tassel upon their hats for their achievement.
Master

The Rank of Master are veterans of the Neuhumanist Rite of "University". They have trained their mind to precieve the true clear rational of reason, they have made a great step into all the rites and have thus grasp a considerable understanding of divine reason. As such they are honored with a gold sash upon their robes for their achievement.
Doctoral

The Rank of Doctor are elites of the Neuhumanist Rite of "University". They have trained their mind to precieve the true clear rational of reason, they are but few that have completed all the rites and have thus grasp a clear and unabstructed understanding of divine reason. Neuhumanist far and wide have come to seek the council of this wise teacher of faith.
Alevi

Alevis are a movement who adoration for Imam Ali, has squarely placed it in the Shia Tradition of Islam. While similar to Twelvers, there exist distinct differences which blends their increased spirituality and focus on the patronage of sufi orders into a tafsir of Inward-Oriented Sufi mysticism. This focus culiminating to elucidating the nature of the duality of humanity and the Perfected Form of Humanity without Original Sin.
Cult of the Apostles

This character is a follower of the Holy Apostles, a legendary group whose ancient gospels and martyrdom helped bring the cross to the North, and through their devotion alone broke the hold of the Old Heathen Gods who once reigned supreme.
Cult of the Hidden Folk
This character is a follower of the Hidden Folk, the spirits of the land like the Trolls, Tomte and Huldra.
Sankta Lucia

This character venerates Sankta Lucia, a virgin and martyr, who, however, according to beliefs, fornsed returns to earth and in the clouds of night brings hope and light to beggars left in the frost and to innocent children keeping watch during the winter holidays.
Sankt Olav

This character venerate Sankt Olav, who during the Apostles' journeys through Norway was baptized, so that by dying a martyr's death he did not vacate his throne, but his body together with his original throne was taken to heaven, and from there he reigns over Norway to this day, being its Eternal King and senior of the earthly king of Norway.
Sankte Per

This character venerate Sankte Per who is a patron saint of the dead in fornsed beliefs. According to their beliefs, after death, God's will is enforced by Sankte Per, who stands guard at the gates of heaven and decides on God's behalf whether to admit a given person to Heaven.
Cult of the Elves

This character worships elves, semi-divine beings who rule over forests and underworlds, and who bless or punish their worshippers depending on their preferences and favors. They primarily patronize scholars, poets, and common folk.
Cult of the Wild Hunt

This character worships the Wild Hunt, the Allfather's great retinue, who periodically rides out at night on hunts and takes people to his palace far in the sky. His worshippers beg him to spare them, but they can also ask for a neighbor to be taken instead. He patronizes sinister warriors, who are usually somewhat infamous.
Cult of the Fiddler

This character worships the Fiddler, also known as Fossegrim, a water spirit who lives in bodies of water and teaches fiddling in exchange for offerings. He is the patron saint of poets and musicians.
Cult of the Thor

This character worship Thor, son of Allfather, who survived Ragnarok and slew the terrible serpent Jormungand. According to Nysed beliefs, worshiping him brings victory in battle and success in conquests.
Latin Rite

This character follows the Latin Rite, the largest of the sui iuris Catholic Rites, which holds the many traditions and rites of Western Europe under the aegis of the Latin Patriarch, the Pope in Rome.
Byzantine Rite

This character follows the Byzantine Rite, an ancient sui iuris Catholic Rite, who upholds communion with the Bishop of Rome. A representation of the Eastern Catholic Tradition the esteems patriarchal seats of Antioch and The Exarchate of Istanbul hold special reverance among those that follow their lithurgy in Ancient Koine and the various Greek Dialects.
Alexandrian Rite

This character follows the Alexandrian Rite, an ancient sui iuris Catholic Rite, who upholds communion with the Bishop in Rome. It's leader is the Patriarch of Alexandria holds lithurgy in the local Coptic and Ge'ez Dialects.
Maronite Rite

This character follows the West Syriac Maronite Rite, a sui iuris Catholic Rite. Their Patriarch in Antioch holds lithurgy in the local Arabic Dialects while serving in communion with the Bishop in Rome.
Armenian Rite

This character follows the Armenian Rite, an ancient sui iuris Catholic Rite, who upholds communion with the Bishop in Rome. It's leader is the Patriarch of the Armenian Catholic Church holds lithurgy in the Armenian.
Legendary
This figure is only known through oral tradition, fragmentary Old World documentation or is simply surrounded by so much myth that no one can separate fact from fiction anymore.
Devout
This character is a devout follower of [this.GetHighGodName], attempting to follow a righteous and holy path of life.
Sang Capétien
This character is descended from the Martyr-King Louis Laflamme through his sister, daughter, or another relative.
Fount of Honour
This character is the current Monarch and Protector of the Faith of the restored United Kingdom and commands the respect an office of such magnitude is due.
Scribe
This character spends entire days and evenings writing and copying the great tales of their realm, for the latter can not be forgotten.
Painter
This character is a talented artist, whether they're painting portraits of local rulers and nobles, remarkable sceneries or famous battles.
Knight
This character has earned the accolade of chivalry, and is part of a lineage of mounted warriors stretching from the ancient cavaliers of Old Europe.
This character, even through the trauma of the event, can patrilineally trace their lineage to Mohammad.

Gâlibî
This character is a member of the Gâlibî Tariqa.
Khalwati
This character is a member of the Khalwati Tariqa.
Mevlevi

This character is a member of the Mevlevi Tariqa, which was founded by the followers of the great mystic and poet Rumi, and carry the spirit of his work with them. They are famous among the Sufi orders for their Sema ceremonies, which involve music and a whirling dance.
Naqshbandi

This character is a member of the Naqshbandi Tariqa, which, much unlike the other predominant Sufi Orders, traces its roots from Abu Bakr, the companion of the Prophet and the first of the Rightly Guided Caliphs according to Sunni Islam, rather than from Ali. Because of this, it has always been an order of choice among Sunni rulers in times of sectarian conflict.
Ni'matullahi
This character is a member of the Ni'matullahi Tariqa.
Qadiri
This character is a member of the Qadiri Tariqa.
Senussi

This character is a member of the Senussi Tariqa, a militant Sufi order strongest in North Africa, whose founder is still remembered even after the event for liberating the lands of Libya from oppressors from across the sea.
Shadhili
This character is a member Shadhili Tariqa.

al-Waqil

Papist
This character believes that the sovereignty of the Vicar of St. Peter and his church on Christendom outweighs the passing national allegiance of its composing peoples.
Populares
This character believes that the self-sovereignty of the people over their own land outweighs the sovereignty of the church and that the realm of God is not of this world.
Defensor Fidei
This character has been entrusted by the Lord God and his holy Vicar to stand guard over the flock of the Saviour.
Akhbari

Akhbari are a movement of twelver shiite that do not accept the tenets of Taqleed and thus do not ascribe to principles of Islamic Juriprudence believing that by only studying the hadith of the "The Fourteen Infallibles" one can be certain that it lacks falliable nature of human thought.
Tuberculosis
This character is wracked with the bloody cough known as tuberculosis.
Ismailagha
This character is a member of the popular and traditionalist Ismailagha Jamia, headquartered in the mosque of the same name in Istanbul.
Iskenderpasha
This character is a member of the cultivated and aristocratic Iskenderpasha Jamia, headquartered in the mosque of the same name in Istanbul.
Mujaddidi
This character is a member of the orthodox and conservative Naqshbandi Mujaddidi order, which has wielded significant political power in Central and Southern Asia.

This character has earned a reputation as a fearsome freebooter.
